body.name: Canonical response feasible product
body.construction: \(K=\prod_{c\in C}K_c\), where \(K_c=\{z_c\in\mathbb R^{R_c}:H_cz_c\le h_c\}\), \(H_c=\begin{bmatrix}A_c\\-A_c\\-I_{R_c}\end{bmatrix}\), and \(h_c=\begin{bmatrix}b_c\\-b_c\\0\end{bmatrix}\); every entry of \(H_c,h_c\) is rational and explicitly serialized or reconstructed from \(I\).
